query: INSERT INTO twitch_stream_report_ratings (session_id, streamer_login, report_variant, rating, comment, rated_by, updated_at) VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6, NOW()) ON CONFLICT (session_id, report_variant, rated_by) DO UPDATE SET rating = EXCLUDED.rating, comment = EXCLUDED.comment, updated_at = NOW()
